subject: Mutual Action Plan — governance, dependencies, and go-live readiness
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason@nimblecare.com>, Priyanka Sharma <psharma@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Jason / Priyanka —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and the initial SOW we discussed. I focused the MAP on the milestones we aligned on during the call and called out ownership, key dependencies, and target dates so we have a single source of truth for the run to production.

High-level summary (please confirm or correct):
- Target go-live: 2026-09-01 (customer requested start of September window)
- Success criteria: 95th percentile inference latency <200ms; integration of SSO + workspace-level audit logs; embeddings accuracy validated on 5 canonical prompts with F1 > 0.78
- Key milestones and owners (in the attached MAP):
  1) Security review & data residency sign-off — owner: NimbleCare (Priyanka) — due 2026-07-22
  2) Integration test & sample data ingestion — owner: NimbleCare engineering — due 2026-08-05
  3) Performance tuning (batching + quantization profile) — owner: Redwood (Rishi) — due 2026-08-19
  4) UAT & acceptance testing — owner: NimbleCare + Redwood — due 2026-08-26
  5) Go-live & handoff — owner: both — target 2026-09-01

Dependencies called out in the MAP:
- Completed security questionnaire (SOC2 artifacts) and network access for staging cluster
- Purchase order / procurement timing (PO expected from NimbleCare by 2026-07-30)
- Sample dataset and expected throughput profile (size + QPS)

Action items for this thread:
- Priyanka / Jason: please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/dates or propose changes (by 2026-07-09)
- Priyanka: confirm expected PO date and any required SOW changes for procurement (by 2026-07-16)
- Rishi: I will prepare a short runbook for the performance tuning step and an initial quantization recommendation by 2026-07-12

Attachments: NimbleCare_MAP_v1.pdf, NimbleCare_SOW_v1.docx

If everyone is aligned, we'll move the MAP to a shared Google Doc and convert the SOW to a DocuSign-ready version for signatures.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer

From: Jason Lee <jason@nimblecare.com>

Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (draft) + next steps from today's discovery

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick notes after running this with our security and procurement leads: 

1) Go-live window: we need to shift the target to 2026-09-15 instead of 09/01. Our internal compliance vendor has a blackout period in early September. Can your team accommodate a two-week slip?

2) Security artifacts: we asked for explicit confirmation on data residency (EU vs US) and encryption-at-rest key handling. Because we're storing PHI-adjacent content, our security team will need KMS/HSM details and the SOC2 mapping. We should add a milestone: "KMS/HSM & data-residency confirmation" (owner: Redwood) with due date 2026-07-22.

3) Procurement: PO timeline looks like end of July; however, approval may slide to 2026-08-03 depending on budget committee. Would need the SOW to be final before 07/30 for a timely PO.

I've attached a short redline doc with a couple of language tweaks (returning separately). Overall the milestones look good — just need to capture the two items above.

On the MAP milestone owners: can Redwood confirm who will be the day-to-day RM for the performance tuning step? We want a single contact for questions during UAT.

Thanks —
Jason
Director of Product, NimbleCare
jason@nimblecare.com
+1 (617) 555-0246

Karthik / Rishi / Laura —

Thanks for the MAP revision and for setting up the security sync. The NimbleCare leadership and security committee reviewed Rev1 and confirmed the following: 
- We accept the revised milestone dates and owners, including the added KMS/HSM milestone.
- Procurement has committed to issuing the PO by 2026-07-30 provided the SOW is delivered in DocuSign-ready form by 2026-07-16 (Rishi confirmed this).
- Success criteria are acceptable as written; encryption verification will be part of the security sign-off.

This email serves as our formal sign-off on the MAP milestones and the adjusted 2026-09-15 go-live target, subject to the PO arriving per the schedule and a successful staging UAT. We are ready to proceed to signatures.

Next steps:
- Redwood to publish final SOW to DocuSign (Rishi / Karthik) — target publish: 2026-07-16
- NimbleCare to issue PO — target: 2026-07-30
- Kickoff / technical onboarding — propose week of 2026-08-03 (we can firm after PO)

Please send the DocuSign link when ready and we'll take care of the internal approvals.

Best —
